move: tap Continue: arrow lunges, ripple, step slides on; last tap turns green Finish
how: An onboarding card with three progress dashes, three stacked steps and a black pill 'Continue' button rises in with expo.out over the first 15% of the 4s loop while a cursor glides to the button. Tap at 1.2s (30%): button scales 0.95 with power2.in and springs back with elastic.out(1,0.45), a translucent ripple scales 0 to 30 over 0.6s, the arrow lunges 8px right and elastically returns; step 1 slides out to x -80 with power3.in and step 2 arrives from x 80 with expo.out; the second dash fills with scaleX expo.out. Second tap at 2.45s (61%) repeats and, being the last, rolls 'Continue' up to 'Finish' (yPercent), swaps the arrow for a check popping with back.out(2.5), and tweens the button to green. At 3.55s the card exits upward with power3.in and the cursor fades away.
adapt: Change the step copy and art tiles, the button labels, the green success colour and the dash count; the cursor target is measured from the button rect. Keep the arrow lunge and the 0.45s out / 0.6s in step slide.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card (dots, three steps, btn with ripple, label pair, two arrows) and cursor inside el, measuring BX/BY from the button rect relative to el. animate returns the timeline with taps at 0.3D and 0.6125D and exit at 0.8875D; the from() on the card needs immediateRender:false.
caveats: cursor starts visible and ends faded, so the loop is close but not exact
step and dash state is not reset, only hidden by the card exit
